hooks.command: path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // ""'); deny(){ printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"%s"}}' "$1"; exit 0; }; printf '%s' "$path" | grep -Eq '(^|/)[.]env($|[^/]+)' && ! printf '%s' "$path" | grep -Eq '(^|/)[.]env[.]example$' && deny "Project policy: only .env.example may be read. Other .env files may contain live secrets and must stay hidden from Claude."; exit 0

path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // ""'); deny(){ printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"%s"}}' "$1"; exit 0; }; printf '%s' "$path" | grep -Eq '(^|/)[.]env($|[^/]+)' && ! printf '%s' "$path" | grep -Eq '(^|/)[.]env[.]example$' && deny "Project policy: only .env.example may be edited by Claude. Other .env files may contain live secrets and must stay hidden."; exit 0

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); deny(){ printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"%s"}}' "$1"; exit 0; }; printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Eq '(^|[^[:alnum:]_-])((git|g)[^;&|]*[[:space:]](commit|push|merge)([[:space:]]|$)|gh[[:space:]]+pr[[:space:]]+(create|merge))' && deny "Project policy: Claude must not run git or git-alias commit, push, merge, or open PRs. Leave the work as uncommitted changes for the user to review and commit."; scrubbed=$(printf '%s' "$cmd" | sed 's/[.]env[.]example//g'); printf '%s' "$scrubbed" | grep -Eq '[.]env' && printf '%s' "$scrubbed" | grep -Eq '(^|[;&|()[:space:]])(cat|less|more|head|tail|grep|egrep|fgrep|rg|awk|sed|strings|nl|xxd|od|cut|tee|printenv|env|dotenv)([[:space:]]|$)' && deny "Project policy: .env holds live secrets and must never be printed into the transcript. Read .env.example instead, or pass the file to the tool that needs it without displaying its contents."; exit 0
